name: Decorative radial spotlight glow
description: An accent-colored radial gradient fading to transparent, dropped behind a hero or section as a "spotlight" and bright enough against that surface to read as a cloud floating over the copy. It is a reflex AI decoration — the translucent cousin of the saturated radial halo. Let the surface stand on its own, or light the composition with a deliberate material accent rather than a floating colored haze.
snippet: radial-gradient spotlight glow "inicio" (#79b9a4 a0.22 → transparent) on 1280x704 surface

name: Low contrast text
description: Text does not meet WCAG AA contrast requirements (4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large text). Increase the contrast between text and background.

name: Side-tab accent border
description: Thick colored border on one side of a card — the most recognizable tell of AI-generated UIs. Use a subtler accent or remove it entirely.

name: Nested cards
description: Cards inside cards create visual noise and excessive depth. Flatten the hierarchy — use spacing, typography, and dividers instead of nesting containers.

name: Unbalanced heading
description: This heading wraps with its last line far shorter than the line above, often one word alone. Set text-wrap: balance on headings so the lines come out near even, or rewrite it to fit. Keep it if the break carries weight on purpose.
snippet: last of 2 lines is 35% as wide as the line above

name: Straggler
description: The last line of this paragraph holds one word, which leaves a hole under the block. Set text-wrap: pretty on body copy (Chrome, Safari) to pull a word down beside it. Where a browser ignores it, edit the last sentence or bind the last two words with a no-break space. Keep it if the break is intended.
snippet: "pedagógica." alone on the last of 2 lines (21% of the measure)
